notes: The 13 consolidated or proportionately consolidated operating sites are followed by Pueblo Viejo and Fruta del Norte as affiliate context. Equity-method volumes are outside Newmont operating sales. A separate operator NAV or observable equity value can capture affiliates; avoid counting distributions and the asset value twice.

Every reserve amount and absolute production profile is in Newmont-attributable units. For Merian, divide attributable volumes by 75% for the consolidated operating statements; keep attributable economics or remove its minority interest for equity valuation. NGM and Red Chris are already proportionate.

For an eligible reserve cap, start with reserve-contained metal times metallurgical recovery, or a directly documented recovered cap if used, and subtract forecast FY2026 and FY2027 attributable production. Profiles from annual technical tables are rounded shapes for the post-2027 model and are capped by remaining recoverable reserve; differences from current production and company outlook can be material.

Model end year is a cutoff assumption. Approximate life, reserve life ratios and historical permitting scenarios are distinguished from exact stated last production dates. Closure dates indicate the scope stated in the cited source, which can include concurrent reclamation, decommissioning or a cost-estimate tail. Future mine closure and recognized reclamation liabilities can overlap.

Ancillary metal reserves with modeling_use 'context_only' are already part of site by-product economics or affiliate value. Do not introduce additional sales or cap operations for these metals without matching the company reporting basis.

lihir.name: Lihir
lihir.reserve_basis: Newmont-attributable contained proven and probable metal before metallurgical losses.
growth_exclusions: Resources and unapproved additions beyond the technical reserve case.
lihir.basis_note: February reserve plan shows material mined through 2040 and processing of existing stockpiles through 2043. Cost estimates continue through 2066. Includes the Nearshore Barrier-supported Kapit development.
lihir.profile_note: Reported annual recovered gold from technical Tables 19-2 and 19-3, rounded to 100koz. Different price, throughput and recovery assumptions from current operating forecast.

cadia.name: Cadia
cadia.reserve_basis: Newmont-attributable contained proven and probable metal before metallurgical losses.
growth_exclusions: Unconverted resources and cave extensions outside the reported reserve schedule.
cadia.basis_note: S-K 1300 reserve case includes long-term cave sequencing after PC2-3 and PC1-2. The technical report predates the April 2026 seismic disruption and applies different prices and technical copper recovery. Its dated post-2027 shape does not establish updated company guidance or unconditional approval for all later caves.
cadia.profile_note: Reported annual recovered gold and copper from Tables 19-2 through 19-5. Technical LOM recoveries were 79% gold and 84% copper, compared with reserve release estimates of 81% and 87%.

tanami.name: Tanami
tanami.reserve_basis: Newmont-attributable contained proven and probable metal before metallurgical losses.
growth_exclusions: Future resources and growth beyond the approved Expansion 2 reserve case.
tanami.basis_note: Management indicated approximately 2040 mine life with Expansion 2. Q3 expected Expansion 2 commercial production toward the end of H1 2027. Model cutoff 2040 is the approximate horizon, with annual production paced by the remaining reserve rather than an official annual mine plan.

boddington.name: Boddington
boddington.reserve_basis: Newmont-attributable contained proven and probable metal before metallurgical losses.
growth_exclusions: Other possible pit cutbacks identified outside the reserve plan.
boddington.basis_note: The reserve case ends both mining and milling in 2040, with closure costs estimated through 2059. Additional tailings permits are expected in the normal course. The technical report shows 494kt contained Cu before metallurgical losses versus 500kt in the rounded corporate reserve table.
boddington.profile_note: Reported annual recovered gold and copper from Tables 19-2 and 19-3.

ahafo_south.name: Ahafo South
ahafo_south.reserve_basis: Newmont-attributable contained proven and probable metal before metallurgical losses.
growth_exclusions: Unconverted resources and projects outside the reported reserve case.
ahafo_south.basis_note: Separate Ahafo South technical table runs through 2034, including existing underground and open pit feed and stockpiles. Subika open-pit mining completed in 2025. Ahafo Complex closure costs through 2078 are disclosed jointly across South and North.
ahafo_south.profile_note: Reported annual recovered gold from Table 19-4, rounded to 100koz.

ahafo_north.name: Ahafo North
ahafo_north.reserve_basis: Newmont-attributable contained proven and probable metal before metallurgical losses.
growth_exclusions: Unconverted resources and projects outside the reported reserve case.
ahafo_north.basis_note: February results cite the initial 13-year project life after October 2025 commercial production. The subsequent-period reserve technical schedule presents production through 2044 and guides this reserve case. 2045 and 2046 cash-flow columns contain closure cash flows with zero output. Ahafo Complex closure costs through 2078 are disclosed jointly.
ahafo_north.profile_note: Reported annual recovered gold from Tables 19-5 and 19-6, rounded to 100koz.

merian.name: Merian
merian.reserve_basis: Newmont-attributable contained proven and probable metal before metallurgical losses.
growth_exclusions: Further extensions and development outside the two active pits and FY2025 published reserve case.
merian.basis_note: Suriname's government cited estimated operating life to 2042 in October 2026. The technical operating disclosures point to a new tailings facility after the existing facility approaches capacity in 2027. Mine closure timing remains undisclosed.

cerro_negro.name: Cerro Negro
cerro_negro.reserve_basis: Newmont-attributable contained proven and probable metal before metallurgical losses.
growth_exclusions: Further district expansions and unconverted resources.
cerro_negro.basis_note: District Expansion 1 is in execution with Newmont indicating extension beyond 2038. The base model uses 2039 as the first calendar year beyond that marker, constrained by published recoverable reserves. The approximately 3.5Moz expansion reference is project context and should never be added mechanically to existing reported reserves.

yanacocha.name: Yanacocha
yanacocha.reserve_basis: Newmont-attributable contained proven and probable metal before metallurgical losses.
growth_exclusions: Yanacocha Sulfides was removed from the mine plan and its reserves reclassified to resources at FY2025.
yanacocha.basis_note: Newmont expects mining into early 2027 and at least three more years of residual leaching, with falling recovery. The 2030 model cutoff reflects three calendar years after 2027. 2026 guided production exceeds 500koz contained multiplied by 71% because reported production also draws on already placed leach ore. No separately reported recoverable pad ounces support an exact remaining reserve cap.
yanacocha.profile_note: Analyst declining gold recovery factors relative to modeled FY2027, informed by the disclosed residual leach window. The factors are editable assumptions and are not issuer production guidance.
yanacocha.closure_note: Yanacocha was already carrying out reclamation in non-operating areas. The two water treatment plants are expected to be completed in 2027; total estimated construction spend is approximately $1.8bn, of which $1.3bn had been spent by the Q3 disclosure. Plant completion does not end site closure and water treatment cash requirements.

penasquito.name: Peñasquito
penasquito.reserve_basis: Newmont-attributable contained proven and probable metal before metallurgical losses.
growth_exclusions: Unapproved extensions beyond the dated technical mine plan.
penasquito.basis_note: Wheaton's FY2025 AIF summarizes a partial final year in 2033 and nominal 35Mtpa milling through 2028, superseding the earlier 2032 schedule. Newmont's February 2026 presentation indicated stronger grades from 2028 with Phase 8. Use half of normal annual activity in 2033 as a modeling proxy for the disclosed partial year. Reserve sizes are FY2025 values. The Wheaton stream affects realized sales price and revenue amortization. Physical recovery includes streamed ounces.

red_chris.name: Red Chris
red_chris.reserve_basis: Newmont-attributable contained proven and probable metal before metallurgical losses.
growth_exclusions: Pending open pit extension and the conditional block cave, which targets commercial production in 2033 if approved.
red_chris.basis_note: The June 2025 Rev1 joint application sets out 2027 last existing pit ore and 2028 stockpile processing, subject to review of alternatives. Site-wide FY2025 reserves include underground mineralization and do not form a cap for the existing pit and stockpile case. The latest Q3 release keeps the cave subject to full-funds approval in early 2027.
red_chris.profile_note: Analyst 50% of 2027 production as a lower-grade stockpile-only final year. Standalone remaining recoverable gold and copper tonnes are not disclosed.

brucejack.name: Brucejack
brucejack.reserve_basis: Newmont-attributable contained proven and probable metal before metallurgical losses.
growth_exclusions: Additional near-mine resources, district exploration and unapproved mill expansions.
brucejack.basis_note: The 2020 mine plan in the 2023 permit schedule ends in 2032, with decommissioning through 2035. The newer FY2025 reserve release says reserve life is at least 10 years, with an increase to 2.9Moz. Use 2035 as an analyst minimum-life proxy ten inclusive years after FY2025 reserves, with output limited by remaining reserves.

ngm.name: Nevada Gold Mines
ngm.reserve_basis: Newmont-attributable contained proven and probable metal before metallurgical losses.
growth_exclusions: Fourmile initial assessment and production from Mike or Fiberline. The contribution transaction's cash payment is tracked separately.
ngm.basis_note: Operator's reserve-only schedule is 2026–2058 and covers Carlin, Cortez, Turquoise Ridge and Phoenix. The 2028 model midpoint uses S-1's illustrative 2.55–2.85Moz at 100% times 38.5%. Existing Goldrush was expected to exceed 400koz at 100% by 2028. Later production allocates remaining recovered reserve in proportion to the technical plan's contained-gold curve, averaging grouped periods. Growth requiring separate projects or resource conversion is excluded.
ngm.profile_note: Analyst midpoint translation of a disclosed operator illustrative range, already on Newmont attributable basis. S-1 also presents 2.30–2.56Moz for 2026 and 2.40–2.70Moz for 2027 at 100%.

pueblo_viejo.name: Pueblo Viejo
pueblo_viejo.reserve_basis: Newmont-attributable contained proven and probable metal before metallurgical losses.
growth_exclusions: Resource conversion beyond the operator's reserve plan and Barrick's own Royal Gold stream on its 60% stake.
pueblo_viejo.basis_note: Barrick's technical schedule includes pit mining through 2048 and low-grade stockpile processing through 2049, dependent on Naranjo TSF construction and additional permits. Operator case has 16.4Moz recovered gold at 100%, or approximately 6,560koz for Newmont.

fruta_del_norte.name: Fruta del Norte
fruta_del_norte.reserve_basis: Newmont's 32% of Lundin's standalone Fruta del Norte deposit contained reserves. The separately reported 540koz FDN South is excluded.
growth_exclusions: FDN South and mill expansion pending integrated investment decision as of Lundin Q3; FDN East and other resources.
fruta_del_norte.basis_note: February reserve update shows 5.85Moz group including 0.54Moz at FDN South, leaving 5.31Moz at standalone FDN before 91.2% recovery. The older March 2023 technical plan ended in 2034. Current analyst cutoff 2035 follows roughly ten years from 2026 at 500koz per year on standalone recovered reserves. Newmont accounts on a quarter lag.
